Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC discovery / next steps

Thanks for the call today, Jordan — useful discussion. A couple quick clarifications from our side that will help scope the POC: 

1) Traffic profile: ~400 TPS for tokenization flows during peak windows; average request sizes ~300 tokens.
2) Latency target: tail P95 < 250ms for single-request flows is ideal, P99 < 400ms is acceptable for batch scoring.
3) Cost sensitivity: we want to aim for <$0.0008 per token if possible for steady-state.
4) Quality: precision on fraud detection rule suggestions needs to be > 88% vs our labeled set.

Can you and your team propose a short evaluation plan with owner assignments and timelines? Priya and I are available next week for a quick kickoff.

—Alex
Senior Product Manager
Atlas Payments

Alex — thanks for the clear targets, this is super helpful. Recap below and proposed next steps so we can get the POC scoped and scheduled.

Recap of your success criteria (as I heard it):
- Latency: P95 < 250ms, P99 < 400ms for scoring flows
- Throughput: support ~400 TPS peak for tokenization/scoring flows
- Cost: target ~<$0.0008 per token steady-state
- Quality: >88% precision on fraud rule suggestions vs labeled set

Proposed evaluation plan (high level):
1) Kickoff & data handoff (Owner: Alex/Priya; Due: 2026-03-24) — Atlas provides representative sample payloads, schema, and a 2K labeled examples subset for local eval.
2) Baseline run on Redwood hosted trial (Owner: Rishi; Due: 2026-03-26) — run e2e with Atlas payloads to measure latency/throughput at small scale and validate model selection.
3) Performance tuning & load test (Owner: Rishi/Marissa; Due: 2026-04-02) — kernel selection, batching config, KV caching; increase to 400 TPS to capture P95/P99 numbers.
4) Cost modeling & quantization check (Owner: Marissa; Due: 2026-04-05) — run unit-cost estimates with q4 quantized variant and compute expected $/token.
5) Quality evaluation (Owner: Alex/Priya + Redwood SRE/ML; Due: 2026-04-06) — run labeled set, compute precision/recall, surface failure cases.
6) Final review & SOW draft (Owner: Jordan/Marissa; Due: 2026-04-09)

Attachments: I attached a short POC plan and initial SOW draft (redwood-poc-plan.pdf, sow-draft.docx).

Can we lock in a 30-min kickoff on 2026-03-25 or 2026-03-26?

Best,
Jordan Blake
